recipe.title: Plum & Pistachio Snack Boxes
recipe.description: A simple portable snack pairing ripe whole plums with unsalted pistachios for juicy sweet-tart fruit, nutty crunch and satisfying healthy fats without unnecessary preparation.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Choose ripe but still firm fruit without bruised or split skin.
ingredients.preparation: Wash, dry and keep whole for transport.
ingredients.notes: Use 1 plum per serving. Whole fruit does not scale perfectly for every serving quantity; round sensibly when scaling.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 60 g in total; retail pack size may vary.
ingredients.notes: Unsalted roasted pistachios are ideal for maximum crunch, but plain unsalted shelled pistachios are also suitable.

equipment.notes: Choose containers large enough to hold the whole plums without crushing them.

mise_en_place.instruction: Wash the 2 plums under cool running water, dry them thoroughly and inspect for bruised, split or damaged areas. Keep the fruit whole with the stones in place for transport.
mise_en_place.endpoint: Two clean, dry and structurally sound whole plums are ready to pack.
The pistachios are accurately measured and remain completely dry.

procedure.title: Portion the pistachios
procedure.instruction: Divide the 60 g pistachios evenly between the two snack containers, giving approximately 30 g per serving.
procedure.endpoint: Each snack container contains an equal dry portion of approximately 30 g pistachios.

procedure.title: Pack the plums
procedure.instruction: Place 1 whole dry plum into each container alongside the pistachios. Position the fruit so it does not crush the nuts, then close the lids securely.
procedure.endpoint: Each sealed snack box contains 1 whole plum and approximately 30 g dry pistachios.

corrective_actions.condition: A plum is too large to fit without being compressed.
corrective_actions.action: Carry the plum separately rather than cutting it before transport.

plating.instruction: At the time of eating, bite or cut around the plum stone and eat the fruit alongside the pistachios. Discard the stone.

storage.storage_instructions: For same-day use, keep the sealed snack boxes in a cool place away from direct heat. For advance preparation, refrigerate for up to 2 days. Keep the plums whole and dry so their juice cannot soften the pistachios. For prolonged transport in warm conditions, use an insulated bag with an ice pack.

either_retailer: Unsalted shelled pistachios — 1 pack; use 60 g.

restaurant_quality_features: Ripe plum provides juicy sweet-tart freshness against rich, nutty pistachios.
Keeping the fruit whole prevents moisture transfer and preserves pistachio crunch.
The minimal ingredient list keeps the snack practical while retaining clear flavour and texture contrast.
nutrition_notes: Morning snacks have no minimum protein requirement.
Plums provide fruit, fibre and micronutrients.
Pistachios contribute unsaturated fats, plant protein, fibre and minerals.
Nutrition values are estimates and will vary slightly with plum size and the exact pistachio product used.
critical_success_factors: Use ripe but firm plums without damaged skin.
Dry the plums thoroughly before packing.
Keep the pistachios completely dry until eating.
Portion the pistachios evenly so both servings remain close to the intended energy target.
